<thought>From the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 224.1201. In positive mode this is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. The isotopic pattern shows an M+1 intensity of ~17 %, consistent with a molecule containing about 16 carbons (each carbon contributes ~1.1 % to the M+1 peak). Searching for formulas composed of C, H, and O that match the neutral mass within a few ppm, the best fit is C₁₆H₁₅O (exact monoisotopic mass 223.11229 Da, error < 2 ppm). No other common heteroatoms are indicated by the spectrum. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₁₆H₁₅O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
